findings.location: independent model — '방문자 수와 이해도는 측정하지 않아' / 'We didn't measure visitor numbers or comprehension' / 'Besucherzahl und Verständnis wurden nicht erhoben'
findings.problem: The source states visitor counts and repeat questioners are unknown; it supplies no comprehension results. It does not establish that visitor counts or comprehension were never measured. The model converts absent/unknown information into an asserted history of non-measurement while teaching faithful question-led reporting.
findings.proposal: Replace the second model sentence and corresponding short summaries with KO '이 자료에는 방문자 수와 이해도 측정 결과가 없어 이해 향상을 확정할 수 없습니다.' EN 'The record provides neither visitor counts nor comprehension results, so we cannot establish improved understanding.' DE 'Die Unterlagen enthalten weder Besucherzahlen noch Ergebnisse zum Verständnis; eine Verbesserung lässt sich daraus nicht feststellen.' Preserve the observed 10→4 and 2→9 changes and proposed next checks.
